top_signals.headline: January Ventures 2026: female founder optimism gap closes for first time since 2019
top_signals.summary: Survey of 482 female founders shows 72% optimism vs 22% in 2022, the first time the gap with male founders has closed since 2019. Deal count for women still fell for the 4th consecutive year. AI access and lower starting costs are credited with leveling early access.

top_signals.headline: THENA Capital closes £45M Fund I as first all-female GP team backed by British Business Bank ECF
top_signals.summary: London-based THENA Capital becomes the first all-female GP team to receive backing from the British Business Bank Enterprise Capital Fund. The fund targets medtech opportunities in the US and Europe.

top_signals.headline: Cartier Women's Initiative 2026 application deadline June 16
top_signals.summary: Cartier Women's Initiative offers up to $100K in non-dilutive funding plus a year of mentorship and visibility for women-led, mission-driven companies. Deadline tomorrow.

top_signals.headline: Women TechEU 2 reopens with €12M in €75K equity-free grants, first cutoff June 30
top_signals.summary: The European Innovation Council relaunches Women TechEU with €12M to support women-led deep-tech startups. €75K equity-free grants plus business acceleration. First cutoff June 30, 2026.

top_signals.headline: PitchBook Q1 2026: all-female teams received 0.6% of VC funding, down from 1% in 2024
top_signals.summary: PitchBook Q1 2026 Venture Monitor shows all-female founding teams captured just 0.6% of US VC dollars, a sharp decline from the 1% benchmark of 2024 and far below the 2019 peak.
